Physical_Quantity_NetFlow: Packets sent from client to server
Physical_Quantity_CICFlowMeter: Packets sent in forward direction
Technical_Evidence_Rationale: Identical integer count of forward packets transmitted from flow initiator.

Physical_Quantity_NetFlow: Packets sent from server to client
Physical_Quantity_CICFlowMeter: Packets sent in backward direction
Technical_Evidence_Rationale: Identical integer count of backward packets transmitted in response direction.

Physical_Quantity_NetFlow: IP octet sum from client to server
Physical_Quantity_CICFlowMeter: Total length of forward packets
Technical_Evidence_Rationale: Identical cumulative sum of IP payload and header bytes in forward direction.

Physical_Quantity_NetFlow: IP octet sum from server to client
Physical_Quantity_CICFlowMeter: Total length of backward packets
Technical_Evidence_Rationale: Identical cumulative sum of IP payload and header bytes in backward direction.

Physical_Quantity_NetFlow: Maximum packet length in bidirectional flow
Physical_Quantity_CICFlowMeter: Maximum packet length across flow
Technical_Evidence_Rationale: Both extract the maximum single IP packet size observed across the entire bidirectional flow.

Physical_Quantity_NetFlow: Minimum packet length in bidirectional flow
Physical_Quantity_CICFlowMeter: Minimum packet length across flow
Technical_Evidence_Rationale: Both extract the minimum single IP packet size observed across the entire bidirectional flow.

Physical_Quantity_NetFlow: Transport-layer protocol identifier
Physical_Quantity_CICFlowMeter: Transport-layer protocol identifier
Technical_Evidence_Rationale: Identical IANA protocol number (e.g. 6=TCP 17=UDP 1=ICMP).

Physical_Quantity_NetFlow: Time difference between first and last packet
Physical_Quantity_CICFlowMeter: Time difference between first and last packet
Technical_Evidence_Rationale: Measures the identical physical duration but differs by a 1000x scale factor (ms vs us). Directly convertible via 1e-3 scale factor.

Physical_Quantity_NetFlow: Maximum IP packet length in flow
Physical_Quantity_CICFlowMeter: Maximum packet length in forward direction
Technical_Evidence_Rationale: Directionality mismatch: nProbe evaluates both directions whereas CICFlowMeter evaluates forward packets only.

Physical_Quantity_NetFlow: Minimum IP packet length in flow
Physical_Quantity_CICFlowMeter: Minimum packet length in forward direction
Technical_Evidence_Rationale: Directionality mismatch: nProbe evaluates both directions whereas CICFlowMeter evaluates forward packets only.

Physical_Quantity_NetFlow: Forward bytes transferred in second sampled interval
Physical_Quantity_CICFlowMeter: Bidirectional transfer rate per second
Computation_CICFlowMeter: Total bytes divided by duration in seconds
Technical_Evidence_Rationale: Rate calculation mismatch: instantaneous sub-sampled window volume vs average flow-wide transfer rate.

Physical_Quantity_NetFlow: Peak TCP advertised window size in forward direction
Physical_Quantity_CICFlowMeter: Initial TCP advertised window size in forward direction
Computation_CICFlowMeter: TCP window in initial SYN packet
Technical_Evidence_Rationale: Aggregation mismatch: peak dynamic window size across flow lifetime vs static initial SYN handshake window.

Physical_Quantity_NetFlow: Peak TCP advertised window size in backward direction
Physical_Quantity_CICFlowMeter: Initial TCP advertised window size in backward direction
Computation_CICFlowMeter: TCP window in initial SYN/ACK packet
Technical_Evidence_Rationale: Aggregation mismatch: peak dynamic window size across flow lifetime vs static initial SYN/ACK handshake window.

Physical_Quantity_NetFlow: Forward transmission bitrate
Physical_Quantity_CICFlowMeter: Total cumulative forward packet header size
Technical_Evidence_Rationale: Dimensional mismatch: transmission rate (bits/sec) mapped to cumulative packet header storage (bytes).

Physical_Quantity_NetFlow: Backward transmission bitrate
Physical_Quantity_CICFlowMeter: Total cumulative backward packet header size
Technical_Evidence_Rationale: Dimensional mismatch: transmission rate (bits/sec) mapped to cumulative packet header storage (bytes).

Physical_Quantity_NetFlow: Cumulative bitwise-OR mask of all TCP control bits
Physical_Quantity_CICFlowMeter: Count of forward packets with PSH flag set
Technical_Evidence_Rationale: Semantic representation mismatch: bitwise cumulative state mask (0-255) mapped to discrete forward PSH flag count.

Physical_Quantity_NetFlow: Count of retransmitted packets from source
Physical_Quantity_CICFlowMeter: Average packet count per forward bulk transfer
Technical_Evidence_Rationale: Semantic phenomenon mismatch: packet loss recovery count mapped to bulk data transmission state statistic.

Physical_Quantity_NetFlow: Count of retransmitted packets from destination
Physical_Quantity_CICFlowMeter: Average packet count per backward bulk transfer
Technical_Evidence_Rationale: Semantic phenomenon mismatch: packet loss recovery count mapped to bulk data transmission state statistic.

Physical_Quantity_NetFlow: Bytes retransmitted from source
Physical_Quantity_CICFlowMeter: Average byte count per forward bulk transfer
Technical_Evidence_Rationale: Semantic phenomenon mismatch: packet loss recovery volume mapped to bulk data transmission state statistic.

Physical_Quantity_NetFlow: Bytes retransmitted from destination
Physical_Quantity_CICFlowMeter: Average byte count per backward bulk transfer
Technical_Evidence_Rationale: Semantic phenomenon mismatch: packet loss recovery volume mapped to bulk data transmission state statistic.

Physical_Quantity_NetFlow: Count of packets with total length <= 128 bytes
Physical_Quantity_CICFlowMeter: Count of forward packets in current subflow
Technical_Evidence_Rationale: Structural mismatch: packet size histogram bin count (<= 128 bytes) mapped to temporal subflow decomposition counter.
